attack-execute-south.action: South/front-facing bow release: settle, draw, full draw, release, recoil, return-to-ready. Keep the complete hooded archer and the entire bow inside every slot. The arrow must remain attached to the bowstring or be omitted; no detached projectile, magic effect, trail, glow, or particles.
